title: User preferences
description: The whole 'preferences' state document (/config/preferences.json). Unlike the other schemas here it describes a full document, not one entry in a collection, since preferences has no array/map of entries.

display_name.description: How the user wants to be addressed. May be empty.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. 'America/New_York', 'UTC'). Used to schedule tasks and display timestamps.

theme.description: UI color theme. 'system' follows the OS light/dark preference.

nav_collapsed.description: Whether the primary nav rail renders collapsed to icons-only.

pinned_panel.description: Which right-hand panel, if any, is docked open instead of floating as a modal. null means none pinned.
